title: How Much Fiber in Peanut Butter? 1.6g per 2 Tbsp
description: Peanut Butter: about 1.6 g of fiber per 2 tbsp (6% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.
h1: How much fiber is in peanut butter?

answer.note: USDA FoodData Central, Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

intro: Peanut butter ranks #7 of 7 nuts, seeds, and treats on this site for fiber per serving. Every figure below is scaled from USDA FoodData Central, the same data the calculator uses.

dataTable.caption: Fiber in peanut butter by portion
dataTable.note: Fiber and calories are scaled from USDA FoodData Central per-100 g values (rows listed under Sources). % Daily Value uses the 28 g reference on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels. Brands, ripeness, and cooking change real values.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in peanut butter?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists peanut butter, smooth style, without salt at 5 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (2 tbsp; 32 g) therefore has about 1.6 g of fiber and 191 calories. That is 6% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 6% of a 25 g day and 4% of a 38 g day.
Peanut butter gives a modest amount of fiber per spoonful, and peanuts themselves are legumes. The fiber matters less than what you put it on: whole-grain bread, apples, and oats.

sections.heading: Natural vs regular peanut butter
paragraphs: Natural peanut butter (just peanuts and salt) and regular peanut butter with added oil and sugar have similar fiber per tablespoon, because the peanuts are most of both.
Powdered peanut butter removes much of the fat. Check the label: fiber per serving is usually similar or slightly lower because the serving is smaller.

sections.heading: How peanut butter compares with other nuts, seeds, and treats
paragraphs: Of the 7 nuts, seeds, and treats on this site, peanut butter ranks #7 for fiber per typical serving and #7 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 0.8 g of fiber per 100 calories. Peanut butter is calorie-dense, so the portion matters more than the fiber per gram.

Close neighbors by serving: [pumpkin seeds](/fiber-in-pumpkin-seeds) at 1.7 g (1 oz hulled kernels (pepitas)); [walnuts](/fiber-in-walnuts) at 1.9 g (1 oz (about 14 halves)); [flaxseed](/fiber-in-flaxseed) at 2.8 g (1 tbsp, whole). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), peanut butter is #50 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding peanut butter to your day
paragraphs: Spread on whole-grain toast with banana slices, or dip apple slices in it.

Example: 2 tbsp peanut butter, 2 slices whole wheat bread, 1 banana. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 8.5 g of fiber, with 1.6 g from the peanut butter. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of peanut butter?
faqs.a: 5 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in peanut butter (1 tbsp)?
faqs.a: About 0.8 g, for 16 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.
A little: about 1.6 g per 2 tablespoons in USDA data.
Almond butter is usually somewhat higher in fiber per tablespoon. Compare labels.
